scope: Abstract already-validated dependency graphs only; not UMF input syntax or native acceptance evidence
comparison: Exact UTF-8 bytes; ready SCCs compare sorted member vectors lexicographically; emit all members before selecting another ready SCC

cases.name: utf8_not_utf16
cases.reason: Default JavaScript string comparison orders the supplementary character first; byte comparison must order U+E000 first.

cases.name: emit_complete_component
cases.reason: Ready component [A,Z] precedes [B]; emitting A does not interleave B before Z.

runnerObligations: For every valid case enumerate all node-order and edge-order permutations; compare complete expected output, not only membership.
Duplicate identical dependency edges, where the admitted graph profile permits them, cannot change the order; charge every observed edge before deduplication.
Invalid cases refuse before persisted ord or any candidate effects; a pure refusal is not native rollback proof.
Use the independent expected arrays directly; do not derive expected orders with the production SCC or comparison helper.
Finite resource boundary tests require the selected operation resource profile and remain separate from these small graphs.
